43.03957,-70.89024: This dial was created by Warren Lester Lane in May of 1881, in Stratham NH. Lester made this dial to represent the mileage and location of 52 geographical landmarks and also a tribute to the Lane Family who had presided over this land for four generations.
43.34428,-70.54638: In memoriam Rachel Carson National Wildlife Refuge "....All the life of the planet is interrelated ....each species has its own ties to others, and....all are related to the Earth. This is the theme of 'The Sea Around Us,' and the other sea books, and it is also the message of 'Silent Spring'." Rachel L. Carson 1907 – 1964 U.S. Department of the Interior Bureau of Sport Fisheries and Wildlife June 27, 1970
